'''Dijkstra''' is an [[NPC]] in ''[[Arknights]].'' He is a background character in [[Episode 09]] who is previously mentioned in [[Heart of Surging Flame]].

==Background==
Dijkstra is a close friend of [[Closure]] and [[Destructive Dragon Demon|D.D.D.]] the singer<ref>[[OF-EX1/Story|OF-EX1]]</ref> who is known to be an excellent computer hacker. Due to having the same hobby, he and Closure would like to mess with the computer system of many countries such as [[Siesta]] and [[Kazimierz]] during the [[Near Light|24th Major season]]. He is known to be residing in [[Columbia]] currently, at least according to Closure's account. 

Without her knowing, however, Dijkstra has already left the country and joined the post-[[Chernobog Crisis|Chernobog crisis]] [[Reunion]] after he was aspired by a poor [[Infected]] friend. Due to his health condition, Dijkstra's friend lost his possession, his family, and a comfortable life. Even though Dijkstra helped him once out of pity, his misery did not end. By the time he met his friend again at the wilderness of Columbia, he had already join Reunion. Seeing the inspiring spirts of the Reunion fighters and learning the harsh oppression onto the Infected across Terra, Dijkstra finally decided to join them in hope of changing the world just like Closure.<ref name=":0">[[9-21]]</ref> 

==Story==

===Episode 09===
Prior to [[Rhodes Island]]'s advance to the [[Victoria]]n capital of [[Londinium]], Dijkstra sends an e-mail to Closure. While he talks about the good old days between the two, he also mentions the story of his Infected friend and how he eventually joined an infected organization. '''Jie''' is an [[NPC]] in ''[[Arknights]]''. She is mentioned in various instances over the [[Through the Ages]] story arc and [[Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries]] before personally appearing in flashbacks on [[First of A Thousand Autumns]].

A replica of Jie's true form is one of the possible final bosses of Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries under the name [[Sui (Sui's Garden of Grotesqueries)|"Sui"]].

==Background==
The fifth sibling and third sister, Jie was one of the twelve proxies of [[Sui]] whose power was associated with writing and calligraphy. She was a caring and concerned sister who often took it upon herself to look after her siblings, sometimes to the point of nagging. Despite this, she was also known for her gentle and kind nature, showing care not only for her family but also for others. [[Shu]] described her as the wiliest of the Sui sisters. She was also the type of person who was very skilled at understanding everyone while making them feel understood as she loved helping.<ref name="HS-ST-3">[[HS-ST-3]]</ref>

'''Sonny Romano''' is an [[NPC]] in ''[[Arknights]]''. He is a supporting character in [[Dorothy's Vision]].

==Background==
A native from the [[Columbia]]n town of Steelham, Sonny is a young, [[Infected]] [[Vulpo]] man working as the leader of  a Frontier pioneer team in the outskirts of [[Trimounts]], who's noted for his distrust towards [[Rhine Lab]]'s staff due to their experiments in the nearby Test Site 359.

Before becoming a pioneer, he worked as a lawyer following various courses. He promised his childhood friend [[Mary Banner]] to help her protect the country and bring bad guys to justice, just like in the games both played in their childhood.<ref>[[DV-1/Story#After operation|DV-1 After]]</ref><ref name=":0">[[DV-4/Story|DV-4 Before]]</ref> Things changed four years ago when he contracted [[Oripathy]], which forced him to finish and quit his internship. Sonny disliked living as an Infected, as that implied a receiving a different, worse treatment from people towards him, and facing expensive health insurance that would let him theorically live a relatively normal life. Indeed, he stopped paying for his insurance premiums only six months after being registered as Infected due to financial problems, thus risking his citizenship.<ref name=":0"/><ref name=":1"/>  

Out of desperation, Sonny once broke into Mary's house and forced her to give money for the insurance. Said incident not just scared her grandmother, but also got her sick.<ref name=":1">[[DV-7/Story|DV-7 Before]]</ref> Having passed more than 3 years since his registration as Infected,  he would eventually find a job in a pioneer team, unaware of what he would experience later.<ref name=":0"/>
